Unauthorized access, manipulation, or interference with me or my programming, data storage modules, or other systems will result in detonation of four point two kilos of plitex nine explosive.&hellip;|[[A-Cee]]'s self-destruct sequence|audio=PlitexNine-DFSftE.flac|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Plitex nine''' was a high explosive.

The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[A-Cee]] was equipped with four point two kilos of the explosive, which was detonated in his self-destruct sequence aboard [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dol Donar's yacht]].
